recentItems.title: The Scott Brown Interview That Changed The Story
recentItems.description: Tim Rice goes behind his story on Scott Brown’s attempted political comeback in New Hampshire, joined by Daily Wire editor-in-chief Brent Scher. The two examine Brown’s return to the campaign trail, his outdated Tea Party-era messaging, and the contradictions in his pitch to voters. They also explore how the Republican Party has changed from the Tea Party to MAGA populism and why Brown’s campaign against John Sununu fell short.
